[[File:Rulebook-2.0-card-p04-1.png|thumb|right|Deploy cost on a character card (Rulebook 2.0)]]
'''Card layout''' describes where the gameplay information sits on a ''Star Wars'' CCG card. Most of the terms below are defined in Decipher's Glossary 2.0.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

== Title and uniqueness ==
Dots before a card title mark it unique (•) or restricted (••, ••• and so on): the number of dots is the maximum number of cards with that title on table at once. A diamond (◊) works the same way but per system.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref> See [[Uniqueness]] and [[Persona]].

== Card type ==
The icon in the upper left-hand corner shows the card type. Sites, systems and sectors have no upper-left icon and share the card type "location".<ref name="gl20" /> See [[Card Type]].

== Destiny ==
The destiny number is in the top right corner. To draw destiny, a player reveals the top card of the Reserve Deck and uses that number; location cards have destiny 0. Battle destiny, weapon destiny and other labeled draws all work the same way.<ref name="gl20" />

== Deploy cost ==
Characters, vehicles and starships list their deploy cost in a small white box. This is the Force a player must use to deploy the card.<ref name="rb20" /> A card with no deploy cost box and no cost in its game text deploys for free.<ref name="gl20" />

== Forfeit ==
The forfeit value, in a small black box, is the amount of attrition or battle damage satisfied by forfeiting that card in a battle.<ref name="rb20" /><ref name="gl20" />

== Power ==
Power is the overall strength of a character, vehicle or starship (experience, training, tactical skill, built-in weaponry). Total power decides who wins a battle.<ref name="gl20" />

== Ability ==
Ability is a character's capability to use the Force. It gives presence and control at a location, allows battle destiny at 4 or more, and serves as defense value against weapons unless the character has armor.<ref name="gl20" />

== Movement and other attributes ==
Characters have landspeed 1; vehicles list their landspeed, and starships list hyperspeed. Vehicles and starships may also show armor or maneuver.<ref name="rb20" /><ref name="gl20" />

== Icons ==
Locations show Force icons (blue lightsabers for the Light Side, red for the Dark Side) that set how much Force each player activates and how much can be Force drained there.<ref name="rb20" /> Characters may show skill icons such as pilot and warrior; the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Icon guide|Rulebook 2.0 icon guide]] lists card-type, skill, set and location icons.

== Lore ==
Lore is background text about the character, starship, weapon and so on. It sometimes contains gameplay terms, often but not always in boldface.<ref name="gl20" />

== Game text ==
Game text is the gameplay information in the large text block at the bottom of the card (or on each half of a location). Canceling game text does not affect the card's other attributes, such as power, landspeed, forfeit, lore or icons.<ref name="gl20" />
